item.title: Exact Copy App Ad

exact_text: Plan your day in one place.

turns.text: Create a silent 9-second 16:9 ad for my fictional planning app DayNest. Three equal-length scenes with these exact lines, one per scene in this order: 'Less scrolling. More doing.' / 'Plan your day in one place.' / 'Try DayNest today.' Keep capitals and punctuation exactly. No other visible words, even in the background. Use simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes on cream and green.

item.tests: Renders exact ordered on-screen copy with correct punctuation and no extraneous text in a landscape app ad.

answer_sheet.Exact on-screen copy:
Scene 1: Less scrolling. More doing.
Scene 2: Plan your day in one place.
Scene 3: Try DayNest today.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Cream and green with simple animated calendar and checkmark shapes; layout and font are your call.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Silent; English text exactly as supplied.

must_haves: The final video is 9 seconds long, landscape 16:9, with three equal 3-second scenes.
The first scene reads exactly 'Less scrolling. More doing.'
The second scene reads exactly 'Plan your day in one place.'
The third scene reads exactly 'Try DayNest today.'
Only those lines appear as visible text, legibly and without altered capitalization or punctuation.
The video is silent and uses cream-and-green calendar and checkmark animation.

turns.text: make an ad for my planning app

dialog.agent:
Happy to make the ad. I need a few details first:

1. How long should it be?
2. Where will this be shown or posted (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, a website, print, somewhere else)?
3. Should it have sound: music, a voice, or silent?

It would also help to know your app's name and any text or slogan you want on screen. If you have a logo or screenshot, attach it and I can use it in the ad.
dialog.why: The assistant asks for the ad's length, where it will be shown, sound preference, the app name, and any assets, and waits for the answers before making anything.

dialog.agent:
OK, 9 seconds. I still need two things:

1. Where will this be shown or posted (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, a website, print, somewhere else)?
2. Should it have sound: music, a voice, or silent?

If you want your app's name or a slogan on screen, tell me the exact words. Otherwise I'll leave text out.
dialog.why: The reply asks the user where the video will be posted and whether it should have sound, then waits for the answers.

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the ad. Your Magic Hour account doesn't have enough credits for this video, so nothing was made and no credits were spent.

A 9-second, 480p video should cost about 216 credits (24 per second). I can't see your exact balance from here, but you can check it on your Magic Hour account page.

Here's what you can do:

1. **Add credits** (buy a credit pack or upgrade your plan). Then I'll make the 9-second video as planned.
2. **Make it shorter.** A 3–5 second video costs about 72–120 credits, which might fit your balance.
3. **Make a still image instead.** An ad image for your app costs only about 5–10 credits.

The ad will be wide (16:9, for YouTube) with no sound or on-screen text. It shows someone overwhelmed by sticky notes who opens a clean, colorful planner on her phone, checks off tasks and ends up relaxed at a tidy desk. You can also send your app's name or a slogan if you'd like them added.

style.prompt: Bright, modern commercial style. A young professional sits at a cluttered desk covered in scattered sticky notes and papers, looking overwhelmed. She picks up her smartphone and taps the screen, which shows a clean, colorful planner app with neat calendar blocks and checklists (no readable text). The camera slowly pushes in on the phone as tasks get checked off with satisfying animations. Cut to her relaxed and smiling, the desk now tidy, warm morning sunlight through a window, a cup of coffee beside her. Soft natural lighting, shallow depth of field, clean pastel color palette, smooth cinematic camera movement. No on-screen text, no captions, no logos.
